text: Visitors have noted several issues that need attention, including confusion about ticket purchasing since tickets must be bought online in advance and cannot be purchased on site. Parking has been a problem, especially with large vehicles taking multiple spaces. Crowding inside the library has made it difficult for some to fully engage with the exhibits, and the lack of clear directional signage contributed to visitors missing sections. Some reviews criticized the heavy reliance on AI in interactive exhibits, which affected their experience. On the positive side, many visitors appreciated the architecture and the variety of interactive elements.

Several reviews mentioned frustration with the timed entry system, including the need to purchase tickets online well in advance and the inability to buy tickets on-site. Some found the visitor flow confusing, with no clear signage or floor markers to guide movement, leading to missed sections. While many appreciated the interactive exhibits, a few felt the heavy use of AI detracted from the experience. There were also complaints about payment methods and limited gift shop options related to the library itself.
